schoolName: Tonga National University — Faculty of Nursing and Health Sciences
reviewNotes: HOLD — Tonga National University's current Faculty of Nursing and Health Sciences explicitly offers nursing, midwifery, pharmacy, medical laboratory technology, oral health and environmental-health pathways, with named collaboration with Vaiola Hospital and health centres. Its official pages do not show a Doctor of Medicine/MBBS degree. Tonga's 2026 government scholarship table directs MBBS awards to Fiji National University rather than TNU, while TNU receives pharmacy awards. Therefore a Tonga medical-university page would be factually misleading; no physician-training candidate is validated.
